# SkyPilot task YAML is parsed and lowered by skycompat, then dispatched by
# the ordinary plan and run RPCs. The test checks each dispatched task.
skygo plan task.yaml
stdout '^local$'
stderr '^task yaml: dropped name: not executed$'

skygo plan -f task.yaml --shell /bin/bash --target local
stdout '^local$'

stdin task.yaml
skygo plan -f -
stdout '^local$'

stdin task.yaml
skygo plan -
stdout '^local$'

skygo run task.yaml --request-id sky-1
stdout '^sky-1\tlocal\tsucceeded$'

stdin task.yaml
skygo run -f - --request-id sky-2
stdout '^sky-2\tlocal\tsucceeded$'

skygo --json run task.yaml --shell /bin/bash --target local --request-id sky-3
stdout '"id": *"sky-3"'
stdout '"/bin/bash"'

-- task.yaml --
name: hello
envs:
  GREETING: hi
resources:
  cpus: 0.5
  memory: 512MB
run: |
  echo "$GREETING"
